artifacts.description: Per-volume configuration file on the hidden root.
Activation state file on the hidden root.
Operation log on the hidden root.
Deactivation self-check reports directory on the hidden root.
Link to the hidden NixOS module, staged in the root overlay's upper on the hidden root; the hidden session sees it as /etc/nixos/nails/configuration.nix.
Fixed runtime directory used by earlier builds. Current builds use a random per-activation tmpfs, so a leftover at this fixed path is a prior version's teardown failure.
RAM-backed copy of the binary, config and mount manifest on the decoy /run; removed on deactivation and emergency.
Runtime udev rule that keeps unused disks read-only in the hidden session ([session_mounts] read_only); removed on the way back, so a leftover on the decoy is a teardown failure.

RAM copy of the binary that the way back leaves on an FHS decoy for its first start, which runs it to make the login and boot records read as a power cycle and then removes it; a leftover means that step never ran, and /run may still be executable.
Runtime one-shot unit the way back leaves on an FHS decoy to reconcile its login and boot records on the first start; it removes itself, so a leftover means it never ran.
Runtime link that pulls the login- and boot-record one-shot into the decoy's first start after the way back; removed with the unit.
Runtime drop-in the way back leaves for a wtmpdb decoy's boot writer, so that it records the way back as a power cycle; removed when the writer starts, so a leftover means it never started.
Fixed overlay pivot staging base used by earlier builds. Current builds stage inside a random per-activation tmpfs, so a leftover here is a prior version's teardown failure.
Decoy-root pivot staging base used by earlier builds; must be absent from the decoy disk. A leftover here is a persistent trace a prior version failed to remove.
Symlink into the hidden NixOS module; must be absent from the decoy /etc/nixos after deactivation.
Import line added to hardware-configuration.nix; must be absent from the decoy base config after deactivation.
XDG autostart entry written into the overlaid home.
Managed shell-integration block marker appended to a login shell rc file.
